content.comment_body: Sales and delivery information regarding the new releases of [product_name] Basic Module FS05 and [product_name] V8.1.1 (SP1) is provided. The updated versions of the [product_name] Basic modules and programming software are anticipated to be available by the end of August 2017. Previous Basic modules FS04 and related software are still available for purchase but will be phased out; once stock is depleted, newer FS05 modules and updated software will automatically fulfill orders. Notes regarding [product_name] V8.1.1 (SP1): At present, technical constraints prevent free upgrading through the Update Center from earlier [product_name] software versions. Instead, files for manual upgrade can be accessed via [url]. Affected devices include several [product_name] models with corresponding [article_no] and FS version details. Key changes to [product_name] FS05 modules with updated firmware include enhanced online test and network modes, parameter adjustments through operator devices, support for simulation software, optimized web server displays, automatic parameter saving, improved copy protection when using storage cards, program compatibility from previous versions, upgraded web server features, and better operating hours tracking. For [product_name] V8.1.1, enhancements are made in signal display, keyboard support for status texts, improved function block linking, enhanced message character display, easier loading from older network projects, optimized zoom, simulation support for forced values, better program comparison and printing, hardware selection warnings, and stricter password management. Additionally, [product_name] Access Tool now supports accurate display and recording of high values.

analysis.insight_summary: This post announces the launch of new hardware and software versions for a modular control product and its programming suite, listing the technical advancements and functionalities introduced. It covers compatibility information, update instructions, and details improvements based on typical user workflow, addressing common needs such as automated updates, backward compatibility, and improved usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a smooth upgrade process, assured hardware-software compatibility across revisions, and clear details on feature enhancements. There is also an expectation for easy access to upgrade files and continued support for older device models within the new software environment.
